corpora.name: C4

method.clip: Augur's forecasts clipped to [0.01, 0.99] as RESULTS.md scores them; entrants' forecasts and market values as published
method.entrant: one (organization, model) pair as published; on C4 pooled over the sets it entered
method.imputed: an entrant's imputed forecasts are excluded, except ForecastBench's baselines (the naive and imputed forecasters are imputed by construction)
method.interval: none for an entrant compared on a single market (null low and high); it counts for no interval-based statement
method.rank: 1 + entrants with a point estimate above 0, among the group and Augur; bottom quarter: rank above 0.75 × the number ranked
method.statistic: Brier(Augur) − Brier(entrant) on the entrant's non-imputed forecasts of the instances Augur scored; positive: the entrant beat Augur

provenance.attribution: ForecastBench processed forecast sets, Forecasting Research Institute (forecastbench.org/datasets), CC BY-SA 4.0; cut down to the question instances Augur's backtests forecast, values unchanged

verdicts.numbers: C2: median Augur − entrant +0.0024 over 22 entrants (worse than the median); Augur ranks 13 of 23 (12 beat it), not in the bottom quarter (rank above 17.25); C4: median Augur − entrant +0.0171 over 77 entrants (worse than the median); Augur ranks 59 of 78 (58 beat it), in the bottom quarter (rank above 58.5)
verdicts.prediction: On C2 and on C4, Augur's no-retrieval arm is worse than the median zero-shot LLM entrant shown no freeze value (point estimate), and ranks in that group's bottom quarter.
verdicts.reading: the median entrant is the median of Augur − entrant over the group's entrants, each on its own non-imputed questions; the group is every ForecastBench zero-shot file without freeze values, including runs that name web search and entrants left with few questions after imputed ones are excluded; bottom quarter: Augur's rank above 0.75 × the number ranked (the group and Augur)

verdicts.numbers: C2: 17 of 22 entrants shown the freeze value (77%) beat Augur with an interval of Augur − entrant wholly above 0 (needed: at least 90%)
verdicts.prediction: On C2, at least 90% of the zero-shot entrants shown the freeze value beat Augur's no-retrieval arm with an interval of Augur − entrant wholly above 0.
verdicts.reading: share = entrants with the interval wholly above 0 / entrants in the group

verdicts.numbers: O: median Augur − entrant over 16 external entries +0.0834 on the same questions (median n 64); 16 of 16 beat Augur (point estimate)
verdicts.prediction: Researched as of open (O, 64 questions), Augur is still worse than the median external entry on the same questions (point estimate).
verdicts.reading: the median of Augur − entrant over the external entries, on O's 64 questions

verdicts.numbers: external entries with an interval of Augur − entrant wholly below 0: 2 (C1 14, C2 16, O 16, C4 309 entries compared): C4: Anonymous 18 / blind-36b1beb99820 -0.0351 [-0.0667, -0.0041]; C4: Anonymous 18 / blind-36b1beb99820+platt209 -0.0379 [-0.0709, -0.0038]
verdicts.prediction: No Augur arm beats any external entry with an interval wholly below 0.
verdicts.reading: every external entry on C1, C2, O and C4; an entry compared on one market has no interval and cannot count
